audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows contradict their own why text: whys[0] says Gnar wins the first trade but win[0] is Skill; whys[2] says 'you stay even' but win[2] is Gnar; whys[4] describes Pop Blossom as her best window but win[4] is Skill; whys[6] calls teamfights 'a wash' but win[6] is Gnar.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Gnar, Gnar, Skill, Skill, Neeko, Gnar, Skill] and matches the prose on every row.
audit.corrected: Chart flipped as one atomic group in both layers; level 1 rated 7/10 for Gnar and level 6 dropped to 3/10 for Neeko.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer phases carried untouched template text ('Stridebreaker is your spike') that named none of this lane's real timings and no cooldowns.
audit.why: The spikes here are level 2 before Blooming Burst ramps, level 6 Pop Blossom, and the first-item Rage window. Tangle-Barbs is 12s at rank 1 with 1000 range — that number is what makes 'trade on her E cooldown' actionable.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].why rewritten to the real story with the 12s root cooldown and its 1000 range stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Pop Blossom interaction was under-specified in the full layer, and the dosFull[2] entry titled 'Manage rage for Mega on demand' carried a copy-pasted Tangle-Barbs sentence instead.
audit.why: Riot's R text: Neeko leaps, knocking up nearby enemies, then stuns on landing — and the preparation is hidden while she is disguised. Against Gnar that means the engage can arrive with no visible wind-up, so the answer is banking Rage before it, not reacting to it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[2].d rewritten to say hold the bar full so her engage meets Mega rather than Mini.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer refers to Neeko as 'his' and 'him' throughout while the content layer correctly uses 'her'.
audit.why: Generated template text that never had the pronoun swapped. Two pages of the same matchup disagreeing on the champion's pronoun reads as machine output.
audit.corrected: Fixed in tradeGood; the same string is duplicated verbatim into breakdown.trading and report[3].t, so those need the identical swap when applied.

edits.before: Boomerang + hop kite wins every melee matchup early. Identify how Neeko contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Mini's ranged autos plus one Boomerang win the first trade — Neeko is immobile and can only poke back with Blooming Burst.

edits.before: Rage management is the champion — track your own bar. Only take the trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down.
edits.after: Hyper's third-hit burst plus a Boomerang chunks a squishy mage for free before her Q poke can ramp.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Neeko must walk into your range.
edits.after: You kite even with Q slow and Hyper speed, but a 1000-range Tangle-Barbs root flips any trade on your Mini body.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Most volatile stretch: strong if Rage lines up for a Wallop, a liability stuck in Mini when her 12s E roots you — it cuts both ways.

edits.before: Mega + R against a wall is the best engage top lane owns. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Pop Blossom leaps in and AoE-stuns at 6, and with no Hop reset in Mini your only out is having Mega banked already.

edits.before: Stridebreaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Tangle-Barbs's cooldown.
edits.after: A full first-item Rage bar turns a baited E into a Wallop wall-ult that kills her outright.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: She pivots to clone picks and Flash-R burst that ignore your front-to-back kiting — teamfights are a wash.

edits.before: Boomerang Neeko's last-hits, AA-hop out of his reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON his engage window.
edits.after: Boomerang Neeko's last-hits, AA-hop out of her reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON her engage window.

edits.after: Boomerang Neeko's last-hits, AA-hop out of her reach, and time Mega so the transform lands ON her engage window.

edits.before: Neeko wastes Tangle-Barbs — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Hold the bar full so her Pop Blossom engage meets Mega, not Mini.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs roots through it, then Blooming Burst lands free.

notes: packet.defects flags 'Her Pop Blossom' in whys[4] as a probable wrong ability name; that is a FALSE POSITIVE — Pop Blossom is correct and the detector matched the name against itself. Two more pronoun errors sit in breakdown.mid ('starve him') and breakdown.feeding ('If he snowballs'); I did not propose those because a bare his->her swap inside those long strings is a rewrite the applier would measure against a length band for no informational gain, and they are safer fixed by a sweep. dontsFull[1].t reads 'Hop into his engage' but is 19 characters, so the applier skips strings that short — it needs the same sweep.
